patient_id.title: Patient Id
patient_id.description: If given, the scan and findings are saved to this patient. If omitted, the image is analysed and nothing is stored.

score.title: Score
score.description: Raw model output, 0 to 1. Not a calibrated probability.

confidence_pct.title: Confidence Pct
confidence_pct.description: score x 100, rounded. See the disclaimer.

heatmap_base64.title: Heatmap Base64
heatmap_base64.description: Base64 of a 224x224 RGBA PNG overlay (no data: prefix). Null when the model produces no heatmap (e.g. tuberculosis).

OrgSettingsUpdate.title: OrgSettingsUpdate
OrgSettingsUpdate.description:
PUT /org/settings. Only the fields sent change; `auto_assign_to_id: null`
switches back to manual assignment.

OrgUpdate.title: OrgUpdate
OrgUpdate.description: PUT /org. Only the fields sent change; `radiologist_count: null` clears it.

scan_id.title: Scan Id
scan_id.description: Set only when the scan was saved (patient_id supplied).

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description: PATCH /auth/me. Only the fields sent change; `null` clears a title or phone.

ReportUpdate.title: ReportUpdate
ReportUpdate.description:
PUT body. Every field is optional; only the fields present are changed
(so a partial autosave never wipes the rest). `null` clears a nullable field
and resets a text field to an empty string.

ScanUpdate.title: ScanUpdate
ScanUpdate.description:
PATCH body. Only fields that are present change; `assigned_to_id: null`
un-assigns. `priority` and `review_status` cannot be null.
